description: Per-agent model routing. Telegram chat uses telegram_model; inbox/work tasks use inbox_model; if a call fails, fallback_model is tried. Pinned explicitly to model IDs to avoid alias ambiguity.

beacon.name: Beacon
beacon.note: Opus everywhere — spec authoring is judgment-heavy and the spec is the contract. Don't economize.

forge.name: Forge
forge.note: Sonnet for chat / routine implementation. Opus for hard tasks (architecture, debugging, security review). Forge can self-escalate to Opus mid-task by setting model in the inbox handshake. worktree_enabled: dispatches go into /tmp/wt-forge-<task_id>/ via worktree_manager; allowed_repos gates target_repo on inbox writes.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.note: Opus for actual reviews. Sonnet acceptable for chat / status queries. worktree_enabled: review dispatches go into a per-task worktree (~/agent-worktrees/wt-mirror-<task_id>/) so Mirror can gh pr checkout the branch and run tests against the PR. allowed_repos gates target_repo on inbox writes (same shape as Forge).

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.note: Sonnet for routine cycles (cheap polling). Pulse can self-escalate to Opus when investigating a recurring pattern. Default cycle frequency starts at 30 min; tune as we earn trust.

aide.name: Aide
aide.note: EA tasks are mostly mechanical (drafting emails, scheduling, calendar holds). Sonnet handles them well. Opus reserved for ambiguous prioritization calls.

scout.name: Scout
scout.note: Sonnet for chat / Q&A. Opus for actual deep research (competitive analysis, technical deep-dives). Scout's output quality matters — research that misleads is worse than no research.

compass.name: Compass
compass.note: Sequencing across multiple in-flight projects is judgment work. Opus default.

loop_bounds._note: D3.5 loop budgets. max_revisions caps Forge↔Mirror revision cycles (5b). max_replans caps Beacon↔Larry replan cycles after Mirror ESCALATE (5c). cost_per_task_usd is the per-task_id spend cap across all dispatches (preflight + clarifications + build + revisions + reviews + replans). Read by outbox_notifier when classifying Mirror markers. See docs/tunables.md for retune triggers.

auto_merge_queue._note: D3.5 5d-prime serializer watchdog. When a PR sits in the auto-merge queue (held behind an overlapping in-flight PR) for longer than this, the notifier sweep DMs Larry once. Raise during planned multi-day absences so the queue doesn't spam him; lower during high-throughput periods. Read by outbox_notifier._load_auto_merge_watchdog_hours_from_config; cache invalidates on daemon restart.

tier1_quota._note: Rolling 5h quota-consuming token ceiling for the Tier 1 Claude Max account. heal_claude_max_burn_rate.py DMs Larry once when the summed costs.jsonl input+output+cache_creation tokens in the trailing 5h window crosses 80% of this. Read at every healer tick (15 min). Re-based 2026-05-28 from the prior $60 dollar threshold (max_5h_spend_threshold_usd) — we run OAuth Max with no per-token billing, so dollar sums were imputed-not-real and false-alarmed every ~15 min on 2026-05-27 while real Anthropic usage sat at 31% session / 59% weekly. The 10M seed is a starting point: it sits above the 2026-05-27 false-alarm period's peak rolling-5h volume (~9.7M tokens) and below historical peak burn (~14M). Don't hand-tune; scripts/pulse_check_viii.py runs weekly against anthropic-quota-events.jsonl and proposes raise/lower/deprecate adjustments via the precision/recall loop (doctrine #48). cache_read is intentionally excluded — it's the largely-free cached re-read and would inflate the signal 10-100x. V1 limitation: costs.jsonl has no per-account field so the sum includes Tier 2 fallback usage — in steady state Tier 2 is rare and the inflation is conservative (alerts slightly early, not late).

haiku._note: Used by heal_tier2_weekly_health_probe.py for cheap liveness probes against the Tier 2 OAuth account. Cheapest viable model — probe is intentionally minimal (~$0.001 per run). Pin the latest Haiku id here; the healer falls back to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 if this block is missing.

_history.change: D3.5 commit 5d: loop_bounds.cost_per_task_usd ($5.00) is now ACTIVATED — outbox_notifier reads it via _load_cost_per_task_cap_usd_from_config and enforces it at all four dispatch sites (_dispatch_build_phase, _dispatch_revision_to_forge, _dispatch_mirror_review, _dispatch_mirror_review_rerun). Cumulative spend is summed by task_id from ~/agents/blackboard/costs.jsonl; at-cap refuses dispatch + DMs Larry. Also: REVIEW_PASS now triggers auto-merge (gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch); REVIEW_EMERGENCY_HALT now trips ~/agents/blackboard/EMERGENCY_HALT + broadcast priority DM. The _note line on loop_bounds (claiming cost_per_task_usd was already read) was aspirational before 5d — it is true as of this commit.

_history.change: E3.2 allowlist expansion: add 'ourliberty-dashboard' to forge.allowed_repos + mirror.allowed_repos. Trigger: task-29-dashboard-ui-e3-2 dispatch dead-lettered because target_repo='ourliberty-dashboard' was not on the allowlist — Forge's worktree_manager and routing_validator gated the write. Trust-boundary expansion is intentional: Forge will commit + open PRs against the dashboard repo (E3.2 + future UI iterations); Mirror will checkout + review-test the PRs. Same Larry-Yatch GitHub OAuth account, same per-task cost cap, same dial-3 regression gate scope. No code changes — pure config expansion. This is chain gap #7 (allowlist scope) — surfaced 2026-05-20 by the FIRST non-agent-core dispatch attempt.
_history.author: Claude (via Larry's session)

_history.change: task-30: add top-level 'repo_paths' block (logical repo name → canonical filesystem path). Folds the two hardcoded mappings (scripts/inbox_watcher.py CANONICAL_REPO_PATHS dict + scripts/cleanup_stale_worktrees.py CANONICAL_REPOS list) into this single source of truth. Both scripts now lazy-load this block via module-level _load_repo_paths()/_load_canonical_repos() helpers and fail-loud on missing block or paths outside /home/larry/ (matches systemd ReadWritePaths). Closes the TODOs in PR #66; collapses the cross-repo onboarding runbook from 10 steps to 8.
_history.author: Claude (via Larry's session)

_history.change: D3.5 5d-prime: add top-level 'auto_merge_queue' block with watchdog_dm_hours=24. Tunable for the AUTO_MERGE serializer's watchdog DM (fires once when a queued PR sits behind a blocker for >24h). Outbox_notifier reads via _load_auto_merge_watchdog_hours_from_config; default 24 is Larry's pick — raise during planned absences. Ships alongside the serializer gates in scripts/outbox_notifier.py that eliminate the 2026-05-26 PR-B + PR-C overlap-conflict incident class.
_history.author: Claude (via Larry's session)

_history.change: loop_bounds.cost_per_task_usd raised from $15 to $50. Trigger: PR-S2 (build-sequence-orchestrator advancer + validator + healer + tests + systemd) tripped at $16.61 mid-Mirror-review-rerun. Larry's direct instruction: set baseline to $50 going forward to accommodate real-code PRs that span multi-file daemon work + healer + tests + multiple Mirror revision cycles. Single-PR cap remains in place as a backstop against runaway loops; raising rather than removing preserves the gate. Self-tuning candidate for Pulse Check VII (cost-ceiling thresholds) once enough at-cap incidents accumulate to inform a data-driven threshold.
